name: data
description: Manage local scientific datasets and model files.

writes.name: research-assets
writes.description: Prepare or download pinned Hugging Face research assets in Data. prepare requires resources and re-resolves file metadata without downloading. Present file size and license, then ask for explicit file selection before download with sourceId and confirm=true. status and cancel accept only action. Use returned source IDs, never invent URLs or paths. Only one file downloads at a time. Calls follow Host/Agent permissions; a Paper handoff is not a permission grant. No code execution or model loading. Query status after uncertain outcomes instead of starting a duplicate download.
